device: Mac mini Apple M4, macOS Darwin 27.2.0 arm64
fixture: 390 × 656 CSS pixels, DPR 3, Chromium 4× CPU throttle. Live Painted Meadow Free play, four towers, 40 durable Goblins over 245 world pixels, scheduled spawns suppressed.
sampling: Fresh Chromium page and context for every sample. Alternate order each round. Two discarded warm-up rounds, 60 rAF callbacks for warm-up per sample, then CDP TaskDuration divided by 240 rAF callbacks and 239 adjacent rAF timestamp intervals. Negative round numbers are warm-ups.

machineActivity.before: No concurrent build, browser suite or benchmark. Desktop background activity included Wallpaper Aerials 11.0%, VideoToolbox 3.9%, transient scratch helper Python 3.3%, Codex 1.1% and Chrome ≤1.1% per process.
machineActivity.after: No concurrent build, browser suite or benchmark. Desktop background activity included Wallpaper Aerials 8.5%, VideoToolbox 4.5%, transient scratch helper Python 3.5% and Chrome ≤1.4% per process.

diagnosticControls: The no-paint probes left the current full-resolution overlay connected and suppressed its clear/draw/fill/stroke calls after warm-up. They used two samples per condition and no discarded rounds. The Canvas probe forced the battle renderer with ?renderer=canvas.

default-main-tip.method: CDP TaskDuration per 240 rAF callbacks with 60 rAF callbacks warm-up; 239 rAF timestamp intervals; fresh context per sample. Painted Free play, Meadow, four towers, 40 durable Goblins and suppressed scheduled spawns.
